title: Initial draw on given map
steps: Open the studio on the small fixture.
expected: Page shows ack 1 rev 0 map title facts 4 cards in 3 stages and 2 lanes and is not busy.

title: Initial draw with no map
steps: Open the studio with map NULL.
expected: Page draws the example map (13 cards) titled Dose calculator validation and is not busy.

title: Title typing held and no-echo
steps: Type a title character by character then deliver a message while focused.
expected: Field holds Infinity seq until flush sends once; focused input keeps typed text while block shows message title.

title: Blank title refused
steps: Clear the title field and blur it.
expected: Server refuses blank title puts server title back keeps rev 0 and shows problem toast with mark and word.

title: Copy in step with real clipboard
steps: Open R code room and click Copy with clipboard permissions granted.
expected: Clipboard holds displayed code via ClipboardItem and toast confirms copy.

title: Copy at once after typing
steps: Type a new title and click Copy in one JS call without waiting.
expected: Clipboard receives generated R code for the new title rather than stale code or bare title text.

title: Copy stays busy while messages held
steps: Hold server messages then type a title and click Copy at once then release.
expected: ClipboardItem write begins inside click button stays busy until ack then writes new code.

title: Copy fallbacks without ClipboardItem
steps: Stub missing ClipboardItem then refused writeText then refused execCommand.
expected: Copy falls back through writeText to execCommand to manual selection with Ctrl+C prompt.

title: Copy timeout when server is late
steps: Set short copy wait hold server messages type title and click Copy.
expected: Button clears busy state sets late status and shows timeout problem toast.

title: Done at once after typing
steps: Type a new title and click Done in one JS call without waiting.
expected: Returned map has the typed title page enters closed inert state and shows closed message.

title: Done stays busy while messages held
steps: Hold server messages type title and click Done at once then release.
expected: Done stays busy and page stays open until closed message is delivered.

title: Room open close and Escape focus
steps: Open R code room then close via button then Escape from inside room and from title.
expected: Room toggles hidden and inert moves focus to heading on open and returns focus appropriately on close.

title: Theme switch and reduced motion
steps: Toggle dark then light theme then emulate prefers-reduced-motion reduce.
expected: Card colour tokens and localStorage update with theme and tray transition duration drops to 0s.

title: Out-of-order answers cannot regress
steps: Hold two title updates and release them in reverse order.
expected: Page keeps newer title code rev and ack without going backwards.

title: Reconnect sends ready first then queued work
steps: Drop websocket type title click Copy and Done then reconnect.
expected: Client sends init then ready then option then done in seq order and completes Copy and Done.

title: Forced-colors focus ring visible
steps: Emulate forced-colors active and focus main shell controls.
expected: Each focused control keeps visible focus outline style and non-zero width.

title: Toast problem contrast in light and dark
steps: Show problem toast in light and dark themes.
expected: Toast problem border edge and mark each meet 3:1 contrast against background.

title: Page reload starts fresh session
steps: Edit title wait for step then reload the page.
expected: Reloaded session starts at ack 1 with original fixture title and no errors.

title: Reduced motion by eye
steps: Enable OS reduced motion and open inspector rooms and play steps.
expected: Slip tray and map steps change without sliding or card glide animation.

title: Copy in Safari by hand
steps: Open studio in Safari edit title and click Copy.
expected: Clipboard contains the updated R code after real mouse click.

title: Copy in Firefox by hand
steps: Open studio in Firefox edit title and click Copy.
expected: Clipboard contains the updated R code after real mouse click.

title: Start card opens when map is NULL
steps: Open studio with no map.
expected: Start card overlay appears over an inert single-card map with template options.

title: Open worked example from start card
steps: Click the worked example option on the start card.
expected: Studio loads example map opens guide and marks the seeded broken link on the stamp.

title: Open blank one-card map from start card
steps: Click the one-card start option on the start card.
expected: Studio loads clean one-card map with no guide and dismisses start card.

title: Open template confirms when edits exist
steps: Make an edit then click a start option once then confirm.
expected: First click asks confirmation without discarding edits; second confirmed click resets journal and base.

title: Facts count updates on structural edits
steps: Add a card then remove a card and observe header facts.
expected: Facts summary text updates card stage and lane counts accurately.

title: Add card at once and with messages held
steps: Type a title and click + Card in one call then repeat with messages held.
expected: Held title flushes first new card gets free id and inspector focus and button clears busy only after ack.

title: Add stage creates new stage
steps: Click + Stage in the header actions.
expected: New stage appears on map with free id and opens in stage inspector.

title: Add lane creates new lane
steps: Click + Lane in the header actions.
expected: New lane appears on map with free id and opens in lane inspector.

title: Stages outline menu navigates and closes
steps: Open Stages menu pick a stage then reopen and press Escape.
expected: Picking opens stage inspector and selects stage; Escape closes menu and returns focus to button.

title: Lanes outline menu navigates and closes
steps: Open Lanes menu pick a lane then reopen and press Escape.
expected: Picking opens lane inspector; Escape closes menu and returns focus to button.

title: Journal hidden until first change
steps: Open studio make two distinct changes and read journal ribbon.
expected: Journal starts hidden then displays numbered entries in chronological order.

title: Same-cell edits coalesce and reverting drops entry
steps: Edit card label twice then restore original label.
expected: Two edits on same cell form one journal entry; restoring original value removes the entry.

title: Undo at once after held edit
steps: Hold a text edit and click Undo in one call.
expected: Edit flushes first then Undo reverts it and marks the entry undone with text label.

title: Undo stays busy while messages held
steps: Hold server messages click Undo then release.
expected: Undo button stays busy and aria-disabled until its ack arrives.

title: Click journal entry targets item
steps: Click an earlier card entry in the journal ribbon.
expected: Inspector opens that card and selects it on the map.

title: Open and close card inspector
steps: Click a card on the map then click it again; repeat and use Close; repeat and press Escape inside the form.
expected: The card form opens on click and closes on a second click, on Close and on Escape.

title: Edit card fields without echo
steps: Type in a card's label and owner, press Enter and blur, change its status, stage, lane, tone, zone, milestone and note, then type again while the server's answer is held.
expected: Held text goes out once or on Enter, each change shows in the journal, and a field with focus is never overwritten by an older answer.

title: Rename card id cascades across links and steps
steps: Change a card id in card inspector.
expected: Links and step changes referencing that card update to the new id with no broken joins.

title: Pick another card while text is held
steps: Type card label and click another card on the map in one turn without waiting.
expected: Held label edit flushes to the first card before inspector switches to the second card.

title: Redraw keeps the picked card, the stage and the player step
steps: Rename the picked card's id; on a map with steps, move the player, choose a stage and add a card.
expected: The renamed card stays picked with its form open, and the player step and chosen stage survive each redraw.

title: Add link from card inspector
steps: Pick a card, choose a card to connect to and a kind, type in another field, then click Connect (at once and with answers held).
expected: The held text goes first, the link joins the card's list and the facts count one more link, and Connect stays busy until its answer is drawn.

title: Inspect link change kind and swap ends
steps: Open a link from a card's list, change its kind to None, type a label and click Swap ends, then Remove link (at once and held).
expected: The kind, the direction and the label change as asked, the form closes when the link is removed, and each button stays busy until its answer is drawn.

title: Remove card or link at once and held
steps: Type in inspector and click Remove in one call then repeat with messages held.
expected: Held text flushes first card and its links are deleted and button stays busy until ack.

title: Edit stage fields and cascade id rename
steps: Edit stage label id note and date in stage inspector.
expected: Stage updates on map and card stage references update when stage id changes.

title: Move stage earlier or later
steps: Click Earlier or Later in stage inspector.
expected: Adjacent stages swap order on map and in generated code.

title: Add card inside stage from stage inspector
steps: Click Add a card here in stage inspector.
expected: New card is created in that stage and becomes the active inspector target.

title: Refuse removing non-empty stage or lane
steps: Click Remove on a stage with cards then on an empty stage.
expected: Non-empty stage removal is refused with reason; empty stage removal succeeds.

title: Edit and reorder lane
steps: Rename lane id and click Higher or Lower in lane inspector.
expected: Lane order and card lane references update on map and in R code.

title: Faulty field shows problem and inline fix
steps: Inspect an item with a broken join or duplicate id.
expected: Field displays problem message and fix buttons that repair it when clicked.

title: Run Trace at once and with messages held
steps: Change trace options and click Run in one call then repeat held.
expected: Call executes with updated options lights traced cards and links and button stays busy until ack.

title: Run Loose ends at once and with messages held
steps: Open Ask select Loose ends and click Run then repeat held.
expected: Answer table matches sm_orphans output and button stays busy until ack.

title: Run Gaps at once and with messages held
steps: Change Gaps parameters and click Run in one call then repeat held.
expected: Answer table matches sm_missing output and button stays busy until ack.

title: Click answer row targets card
steps: Click a row action in Ask answer table.
expected: Inspector opens that card and selects it on the map.

title: Trace from here opens Ask and runs trace
steps: Click Trace from here in card inspector.
expected: Ask room opens with card selected and displays downstream trace results.

title: Edit marks answer stale and Clear unlights map
steps: Edit a card after running Ask then click Clear answer.
expected: Answer shows stale notice and clears map highlights; Clear removes answer completely.

title: Ask disabled on broken map
steps: Introduce a broken join then open Ask room and run a question.
expected: Ask refuses to run on invalid map and points to Check room.

title: Broken map keeps last good map with stamp
steps: Introduce a duplicate id or broken join.
expected: Last valid map stays drawn while red paper stamp states problem count.

title: Check room lists R errors and fault cards
steps: Open Check room while map has a broken link or duplicate id.
expected: Room shows R error message lines and fault cards with fix actions.

title: Apply a fix at once and with messages held
steps: Type in a field and click Apply fix in one call then repeat held.
expected: Held edit flushes fix repairs fault map rebuilds cleanly and stamp clears after ack.

title: Check room reports clean after fixes
steps: Fix all faults and inspect Check room.
expected: Check room shows clean status and zero faults.

title: Done refused on broken map
steps: Click Done while map has a fault.
expected: Done refuses to close and shows notice pointing to Check room.

title: Broken map code view shows problem note
steps: Open R code room while map has a fault.
expected: Code room renders current tables with problem note above code and comment in copy text.

title: Switch layout between Grid Levels and Dates
steps: Open Map room and select Levels with Target then Grid.
expected: Map redraws with chosen layout and R code reflects non-default layout and target.

title: Dates layout warns or disables without stage dates
steps: Check Dates option before and after adding a stage date.
expected: Dates notes missing stage dates until at least one stage has a valid date.

title: Change cards per cell density
steps: Change cell_columns in Map room between 1 2 and Auto.
expected: Map redraws grid columns and R code updates cell_columns argument.

title: Toggle bundle links option
steps: Toggle Bundle links in Map room.
expected: Map redraws bundled links and R code updates bundle_links argument.

title: Toggle legend visibility
steps: Toggle Legend in Map room.
expected: Map hides or shows legend and R code updates legend argument.

title: Code room renders tokens and line numbers
steps: Open R code room on small fixture.
expected: Lines show syntax token spans matching stage_map_code output.

title: Changed lines marked against opening base
steps: Modify a card or option and open R code room.
expected: Changed lines carry data-sms-changed and visible changed label.

title: Last Ask call shown below map code
steps: Run an Ask question then open R code room.
expected: R code room includes the last question call below the map code.

title: Download .R at once and with messages held
steps: Type a title and click Download .R in one call then repeat held.
expected: Download waits for ack and writes R script containing the newly typed title.

title: Download CSV at once and with messages held
steps: Edit a card and click table CSV download in one call then repeat held.
expected: Download waits for ack and writes CSV rows containing the newly edited value.

title: Example template opens with six-step guide
steps: Open the worked example from the start card.
expected: The hint bar shows Next with the first step not done, the button reads Try it 1/6 and the list holds six steps, the first ticked.

title: Guide steps tick on server proofs and stay ticked
steps: Do the six steps with real actions, in the order the list gives, checking the list before each action; then Undo.
expected: Each step ticks only when its action is done and its answer is drawn, a question before the fix is refused, the count reaches 6/6 and Undo takes no tick back.

title: Guide list opens and closes with the keyboard
steps: Open the list with Enter or Space from the Try it button, then press Escape.
expected: The list opens with the step list and Escape closes it, with focus back on the button when it was inside the bar.

title: Phone dock and header controls under 640px
steps: Emulate viewport widths 390px and 360px.
expected: The title block shows four dock buttons, the Map and theme controls move to the header, and the studio does not scroll sideways.

title: Phone opens one room and bottom-sheet inspector
steps: At 390px and 360px open Ask, then Check, then a card, then Ask again.
expected: One sheet is open at a time: a second room replaces the first, a pick closes the rooms and opens the form as a bottom sheet, and a room covers the form until it closes.

title: Phone target sizes and compact journal
steps: At 390px and 360px make two edits, undo one, and measure the dock, the buttons, the form controls and the menus.
expected: Dock and action buttons are at least 44px high, the journal shows the newest entry in full with its word undone, controls use 16px text, and menus stay inside the screen.

title: Real phone touch walk
steps: Open studio on a physical phone and open sheets rooms and map.
expected: Touch scrolling tap targets and bottom sheets work without horizontal overflow.

title: Tab order flows through studio without traps
steps: Press Tab through the page from the skip link to the last control and past it.
expected: Focus visits the header, the map, the hint bar and the title block in page order, every studio control shows a ring, and the focus leaves the page at the end.

title: Keyboard pick and Undo and Escape rules
steps: Use the skip link, pick a card with Enter, change its status with the arrow keys, press Ctrl+Z outside and inside a text field, then Escape.
expected: The skip link lands in the map, the pick moves focus to the form's heading, Ctrl+Z undoes outside text only, and Escape closes the form with focus back in the map.

title: Keyboard-only full studio walk
steps: Complete a full edit trace check and Done flow using only keyboard.
expected: Every studio action is reachable and operable without a pointer.

title: Screen reader announcement walk
steps: Navigate studio with VoiceOver or NVDA across rooms forms and errors.
expected: Landmarks live regions radio groups problem descriptions and status words read clearly.

title: Shell actions leave listener observer timer and node counts flat
steps: Run warm-up then 30 rounds of title edits code room toggles and theme switches.
expected: Listener observer pending timer and DOM node counts return to baseline after settling.

title: Keyboard-only walk by key events
steps: Open the example, pick a card, change its status, connect it, apply the fix under Check, copy the R code, run a trace, change the layout, undo and press Done, using key events only.
expected: Every step works with no pointer event and focus is where it should be after each step.

title: Escape closes the topmost layer
steps: Open a form, a room, the guide list and the Stages menu, then press Escape four times.
expected: The menu, the guide list, the room and the form close in that order and focus returns to the opener.

title: Menu keys and Tab
steps: Open the Stages menu, move with the arrow keys, Home and End, then press Tab.
expected: Menu items are reached by arrows only, and Tab closes the menu and goes on from its button.

title: CSV menu closes with its room
steps: Open the CSV menu in the R code room then close the room with Close, with Escape and with its dock button.
expected: The menu is closed whenever the room closes.

title: Names and reduced motion
steps: Open the form and every room, then emulate reduced motion.
expected: Every control has a name, and the form, the tray and the toast have no transition or animation under reduced motion.

title: Tap opens a card form
steps: At 390px emulate touch and tap a card on the map.
expected: The card form opens, and no control is revealed only by hover.

title: Text contrast of the page tokens in both themes
steps: At 390px and 360px read the page colours in the light and the dark theme.
expected: Every text colour meets 4.5:1 against the background it is used on.

title: Changed word stays in view on a long line
steps: At 360px change the map, open the R code room and scroll a long line sideways.
expected: The changed word of the line is written from the page labels and stays at the right edge of the code.
